variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: LayoutParser is an open-source Python toolkit for document image analysis. It provides layout data structures, model adapters, model-zoo integrations, OCR helpers, geometry operations, and visualization utilities. A typical pipeline uses it to turn a rendered page into typed regions such as titles, text blocks, lists, tables, and figures.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Geometry
pairs.detail: Bounding boxes or polygons locate a region in the page coordinate system and make cropping, overlap checks, review, and replay possible.
pairs.explanation: Bounding boxes or polygons locate a region in the page coordinate system and make cropping, overlap checks, review, and replay possible.

pairs.label: Region meaning
pairs.detail: A model assigns labels and scores, while explicit post-processing decides which detections are safe to send downstream.
pairs.explanation: A model assigns labels and scores, while explicit post-processing decides which detections are safe to send downstream.

pairs.label: Document structure
pairs.detail: Reading order, columns, captions, tables, and hierarchy are constructed after region detection; they are not guaranteed by a box detector.
pairs.explanation: Reading order, columns, captions, tables, and hierarchy are constructed after region detection; they are not guaranteed by a box detector.

variants.hint:
Geometry: Bounding boxes or polygons locate a region in the page coordinate system and make cropping, overlap checks, review, and replay possible.

Region meaning: A model assigns labels and scores, while explicit post-processing decides which detections are safe to send downstream.

Document structure: Reading order, columns, captions, tables, and hierarchy are constructed after region detection; they are not guaranteed by a box detector.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Keeping these boundaries clear helps you find the place to change when the system behaves unexpectedly.

pairs.label: Region detector
pairs.detail: Use a detector when the contract needs page regions such as text, title, list, table, and figure.
pairs.explanation: Use a detector when the contract needs page regions such as text, title, list, table, and figure. LayoutParser's official model zoo exposes adapters for supported detection backends and datasets.

pairs.label: OCR engine
pairs.detail: Run recognition inside selected regions or on full pages when needed.
pairs.explanation: Run recognition inside selected regions or on full pages when needed. Record the OCR engine, language, image transform, word boxes, and confidence separately from detector evidence.

pairs.label: Multimodal model
pairs.detail: Models such as LayoutLMv3 combine text, page boxes, and image features for tasks such as token classification or document question answering.
pairs.explanation: Models such as LayoutLMv3 combine text, page boxes, and image features for tasks such as token classification or document question answering. They have their own processor, task head, training data, and release gate.
